selection: fixed earlier early-close source fixture, independent of strategy outcomes
analysis_window: left-closed right-open; preserve any quote exactly at end separately
count_weighting: each observed mechanically valid noncrossed positive-price positive-size quote
duration_weighting: last observed quote until next timestamp, capped at window end; leading and invalid intervals uncovered; incomplete pages do not extend the trailing quote
condition_policy: preserve all quote conditions; no claim that mechanically valid quotes are executable
side_effects: historical quotes only; no account/order/transfer/subscription access
